question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of fiber optic networks in Spain, with operator and status?

answer.summary: No national open dataset of fibre routes was found. Best official source: Catalonia CTTI cables (2,216 lines, exact geometry, owner CTTI, no status). ITU BBMaps WFS gives national but schematic 2-point links with status and no operator. Operators (Reintel, Digi, lyntia) publish pictures only; the state PIU is restricted to accredited operators.
main_caveats: Gencat coordinates are UTM metres (EPSG:25831 inferred) in a file called GeoJSON; reproject before use. All 2,216 rows have owner and manager CTTI.
ITU links are 2-vertex straight lines between nodes and the Spain bbox also returns Portugal, France and North Africa; they are not cable routes.
RD 330/2016 art. 5 obliges infrastructure owners to give location and layout on written request; the PIU (Orden ECE/529/2019) lists contacts and works only. The 2026 draft order is not approved.
OSM telecom lines in three regions sampled (La Rioja, Navarra, Cantabria) have no telecom:medium=fibre and almost no operator tags.
CNMC and SETID coverage data are municipal or province aggregates of homes passed, not routes.
answer.confidence_reason: Searched all eight site types and opened regulator pages; OSM tested on 3 regions only and Overpass was unreachable, so inland OSM coverage in Spain is not counted.

how_to_use.example_result: count -> [{"count":"2216"}]; first feature properties: {"nom":"CTTI-FO-096-25025CE01PE0006-25025CE01PE0016-T7-2500m","propietari":"CTTI","gestor":"CTTI","capacitat":"96"}, geometry MultiLineString [[333530.98,4725976.63],...]
steps: Download the GeoJSON (8.8 MB, 2216 features) or query the SODA endpoint /resource/7k8h-ana8.json with $limit/$offset.

Set the CRS to EPSG:25831 (ETRS89 / UTM 31N) before use: the GeoJSON carries no crs member and the coordinates are not lon/lat. Reprojecting with pyproj Transformer.from_crs(25831,4326,always_xy=True) put all 325,262 vertices inside Catalonia (lon 0.26..3.27, lat 40.54..42.71).
Read fibre count from capacitat (cast to int) and length from the "-NNNNm" suffix of nom if needed; planar length of all lines is about 4,014 km.
reading_traps: Coordinates are UTM metres although the file is called GeoJSON; the Socrata export endpoint api/geospatial/7k8h-ana8?method=export&format=GeoJSON gives the same UTM values.
propietari and gestor are CTTI in all 2216 rows: the dataset has no operator diversity and no status field.
:created_at is 2026-11-16 for all rows (bulk reload); it is not an installation date.
Only CTTI-managed cables: it is not the whole Catalan fibre network.

steps: Query the WFS with a bbox (axis order lat,lon for urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326) or use resultType=hits for counts.

Only 9 of 949 are planned or under construction; status is not dated.

recipe: Open the project PDF (Aragón PIGA Tomo II Libro B, Documento III) and run pdftotext -layout; the duct table is under heading 3.1.1 (PDF page 6) and 3.2.1.1.
Split each row on the two or more spaces between columns: street, start and end chamber, length in metres, trench type, plan number. Rows are separated by blank lines.
Positions are only street names and plan numbers: grepping the text for UTM, ETRS and coordenadas finds nothing; the geometry exists only in the A2 plan drawings (pages 22-25).
For operator maps (Reintel page 2) render the page (pdftocairo -svg) to get an unreferenced vector map; it has no coordinates or per-segment attributes.
if_unstructured.location_method: Project documents give street names and drawing numbers, not coordinates; operator maps are unreferenced. Only the datasets in sources carry coordinates.
